title: repo-inventory declaration
description: What the account's repositories are supposed to look like. Every repository named here is compared against live state; every live repository not named here is reported as undeclared. No secret and no token appears in this file - the project context names the environment variables that hold those.

_readme.description: Free text carried by the template. Ignored by the loader.

classes.description: The classes a repository may belong to. Declared here rather than inferred from the name, because a rule that guesses which class a repository is in will one day guess wrong about the one repository where it matters.

name.description: The repository name only, never owner/repo: the owner comes from the environment.

class.description: Must be a key of the classes object. Cross-checked by the loader, which JSON Schema cannot express.

description.description: GitHub truncates beyond 350 characters, so a longer value would never compare equal and the plan would report the same change forever.

homepage.description: An empty string means 'no homepage'. The API returns an unset homepage as an empty string and an unset description as null, so both are normalized before comparison.

topics.description: Topics this repository should carry. They are ADDED to whatever is already live, never substituted for it: PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/topics replaces the whole collection, so sending only these would delete every topic added by hand. Removal is reconcile's job, and reconcile does not exist yet.
